modeHelp.anonymous: Anyone with the link can report a problem, near miss or idea without signing in.
modeHelp.whistleblowing: For reporting serious concerns such as misconduct. Reports become restricted deviations that only the person handling them can see.

settings.title: Anonymous report link
settings.subtitle: A public link where people can report without an account. Share it on posters, the intranet or with suppliers.
settings.enabled: The link is open for reports
settings.instructionsPlaceholder: For example: what to report here, and when to call the emergency number instead.
settings.allowContact: Let reporters leave contact details if they want to
settings.linkOff: The link is switched off. People who open it see that it isn't available.
settings.privacyNote: Reports store no IP address, browser details or account. The reporter gets a receipt code to follow up.
settings.rotateConfirm: The current link stops working at once. Receipt codes still work with the new link.

inbox.title: Received reports

intro.anonymous: Tell us about a problem, a near miss or an idea for improvement. You don't need an account, and you don't have to say who you are.
intro.whistleblowing: Use this form to report a serious concern. You don't have to say who you are. The report is only seen by the people who handle it.

receipt.title: Thank you. Your report is received.
receipt.body: Keep this receipt code. It is the only way to check the status of your report later, and it can't be shown again.

hints.title: At least 3 characters.
hints.description: Describe what you saw, when and who was affected. At least 10 characters. Avoid names unless they are needed.
hints.contact: Leave this empty to stay anonymous.

errors.generic: The report could not be sent. Try again later.
